papers.title: The Clinical Utility of Adding Laminin Gamma 2 Monomer to the PAGE‐B Score for Hepatocellular Carcinoma Surveillance in Chronic Hepatitis B
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims A residual risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) persists despite the use of nucleos(t)ide analogs (NA) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients. We aimed to assess the utility of baseline serum laminin gamma 2 monomer (LG2m) by integrating PAGE‐B score to predict HCC. Methods NA‐treated CHB patients whose baseline serum LG2m, alpha‐fetoprotein (AFP) and PAGE‐B score were measured. We evaluated the predictive value of LG2m in subgroups stratified by cirrhosis status and PAGE‐B score and proposed a HCC surveillance algorithm. Results HCC developed in 56 of 1016 patients over a follow‐up of 3651 person‐years (annual incidence: 1.53%). None of the low PAGE‐B patients developed HCC over 5 years. LG2m did not significantly stratify risk in high PAGE‐B patients. Conversely, LG2m was significantly predictive of HCC in nonhigh PAGE‐B patients (5‐year incidence: 5.5% vs. low LG2m, p = 0.004). Integrating LG2m, AFP, and high PAGE‐B achieved a sensitivity of 98.2% for HCC detection. Among patients with a nonhigh PAGE‐B score, elevated LG2m was associated with a higher risk of HCC (adjusted HR, 4.40; 95% CI, 1.26–15.44), whereas AFP did not significantly stratify HCC risk in a separate analysis. Intermediate PAGE‐B patients with high LG2m should receive closer HCC surveillance (annual incidence: 1.4%) as with high PAGE‐B patients did (annual incidence: 1.9%). Conclusion Serum LG2m level was predictive of HCC specifically among patients with intermediate PAGE‐B score. Integration of LG2m into a PAGE‐B‐oriented algorithm provides a biomarker‐driven tool for individualized surveillance, which is vital for improving early‐stage HCC detection.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估在 PAGE-B 评分中添加层粘连蛋白 γ 2 单体 (LG2m) 用于预测 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的临床效用。尽管在 CHB 患者中使用核苷(酸)类似物 (NA),但 HCC 的残余风险仍然存在。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及接受 NA 治疗的 CHB 患者,测量了其基线血清 LG2m、甲胎蛋白 (AFP) 和 PAGE-B 评分。在 3651 人年的随访中,1016 名患者中有 56 名发生 HCC(年度 发病率:1.53%)。低 PAGE-B 患者中没有一名患者在 5 年内发展为 HCC。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法包括测量 NA 治疗的 CHB 患者的基线血清 LG2m、AFP 和 PAGE-B 评分。LG2m 的预测价值在按肝硬化状态和 PAGE-B 评分分层的亚组中进行评估。
elements_zh.main_results: 在非高PAGE-B评分患者中,升高的LG2m与更高的HCC风险相关(调整后风险比,4.40;95%置信区间,1.26–15.44),而AFP在单独分析中未能显著分层HCC风险。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,血清 LG2m 水平可以预测 HCC,特别是在 PAGE-B 评分中等的患者中。将 LG2m 集成到面向 PAGE-B 的算法中,为个性化 监测 提供了生物标志物驱动的工具,这对于改善早期 HCC 检测至关重要。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,将 LG2m 纳入 HCC 监测 策略可以增强早期检测,特别是对于 PAGE-B 评分中等的患者。这可以为慢性乙型肝炎患者提供更有针对性和更有效的监测方案。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对基线测量的依赖而受到限制,并且没有考虑 LG2m 水平的长期变化。证据是中等的,因为它是基于没有随机设计的观察性研究。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景与目的 尽管在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中使用核苷(酸)类似物(NA)治疗,肝细胞癌(HCC)的残留风险仍存在。我们旨在通过整合PAGE‐B评分,评估基线血清层粘连蛋白γ2单体(LG2m)在预测HCC中的作用。方法 收集了接受NA治疗的CHB患者的基线血清LG2m、甲胎蛋白(AFP)和PAGE‐B评分数据。我们评估了LG2m在按肝硬化状态和PAGE‐B评分分层的亚组中的预测价值,并提出了一个HCC 监测算法。结果 在随访3651人年期间,1016名患者中有56人发展为HCC(年发病率:1.53%)。在低PAGE‐B评分患者中,5年内未见HCC发生。在高PAGE‐B评分患者中,LG2m未能显著分层HCC风险。相反,在非高PAGE‐B评分患者中,LG2m显著预测HCC发生(5年发病率:5.5% vs. 低LG2m,p = 0.004)。将LG2m、AFP和高PAGE‐B评分整合后,HCC检测的敏感度达到98.2%。在非高PAGE‐B评分患者中,升高的LG2m与更高的HCC风险相关(调整后风险比,4.40;95%置信区间,1.26–15.44),而AFP在单独分析中未能显著分层HCC风险。对于具有中等PAGE‐B评分且高LG2m的患者,应像高PAGE‐B评分患者一样进行更密切的HCC 监测监测(年发病率:1.4%),而高PAGE‐B评分患者的年发病率为1.9%。结论 血清LG2m水平在具有中等PAGE‐B评分的患者中可特异性预测HCC。将LG2m整合到以PAGE‐B为导向的算法中,可提供一种基于生物标志物的个体化监测工具,这对于提高早期HCC检测至关重要。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估在 PAGE-B 评分中添加层粘连蛋白 γ 2 单体 (LG2m) 用于预测 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的临床效用。尽管在 CHB 患者中使用核苷(酸)类似物 (NA),但 HCC 的残余风险仍然存在。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及接受 NA 治疗的 CHB 患者,测量了其基线血清 LG2m、甲胎蛋白 (AFP) 和 PAGE-B 评分。在 3651 人年的随访中,1016 名患者中有 56 名发生 HCC(年度 发病率:1.53%)。低 PAGE-B 患者中没有一名患者在 5 年内发展为 HCC。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法包括测量 NA 治疗的 CHB 患者的基线血清 LG2m、AFP 和 PAGE-B 评分。LG2m 的预测价值在按肝硬化状态和 PAGE-B 评分分层的亚组中进行评估。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在非高PAGE-B评分患者中,升高的LG2m与更高的HCC风险相关(调整后风险比,4.40;95%置信区间,1.26–15.44),而AFP在单独分析中未能显著分层HCC风险。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,血清 LG2m 水平可以预测 HCC,特别是在 PAGE-B 评分中等的患者中。将 LG2m 集成到面向 PAGE-B 的算法中,为个性化 监测 提供了生物标志物驱动的工具,这对于改善早期 HCC 检测至关重要。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,将 LG2m 纳入 HCC 监测 策略可以增强早期检测,特别是对于 PAGE-B 评分中等的患者。这可以为慢性乙型肝炎患者提供更有针对性和更有效的监测方案。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其对基线测量的依赖而受到限制,并且没有考虑 LG2m 水平的长期变化。证据是中等的,因为它是基于没有随机设计的观察性研究。

papers.title: Semi-quantitative ultrasound scoring reveals hepatic structural recovery and immune modulation during tenofovir alafenamide therapy in chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Objective This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system, and to investigate the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. Methods A total of 100 CHB patients who received TAF monotherapy (25 mg/day) for at least 24 months were retrospectively enrolled. A seven-parameter semi-quantitative US score, encompassing liver echogenicity, capsular contour, margin shape, vessel clarity, portal vein diameter (PVD), spleen thickness (ST), and splenic vein velocity (SVV), was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Concurrently, serum hepatitis B virus (HBV) deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), peripheral T-cell subsets, including cluster of differentiation 3-positive (CD3 + ), CD4 + , CD8 + T cells, CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and natural killer (NK) cell activity were measured. Correlations between US scores and biochemical/immune parameters were analyzed. Results At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The comprehensive US score decreased significantly from 7.86 ± 1.73 at baseline to 3.37 ± 0.95 at 24 months ( P < 0.001), with the most pronounced improvements observed in capsular smoothness and parenchymal homogeneity. The CD4 + T-cell proportion and CD4 + /CD8 + ratio increased, whereas the CD8 + proportion decreased; NK cell activity rose from 42.7 ± 7.3% to 52.4 ± 6.2% ( P < 0.05). The US score was positively correlated with ALT (r = 0.56) and AST (r = 0.47), and negatively correlated with the CD4 + /CD8 + ratio (r = −0.46) and NK cell activity (r = −0.38) (all P < 0.01). Conclusion These findings indicate that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalises liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement, as reflected by declining semi-quantitative US scores. The strong correlations of US scores with biochemical and immune parameters support its utility as a non-invasive imaging biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system. It aimed to assess the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. A total of 100 CHB patients on TAF monotherapy for at least 24 months were enrolled. The US score, which included seven parameters, was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Serum HBV DNA, ALT, AST, and immune parameters were also measured. The strong correlations support the use of US as a non-invasive biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the absence of reported limitations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在利用半定量超声(US)评分系统评估替诺福韦艾拉酚胺二甲基磺酸盐(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)患者中的治疗反应,并探讨超声影像变化与免疫功能恢复之间的相关性。

papers.title_zh: 半定量超声评分揭示慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)在接受替诺福韦艾拉酚胺治疗期间肝脏结构恢复和免疫调节
papers.source_body_en: Objective This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic response to tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) using a semi-quantitative ultrasound (US) scoring system, and to investigate the correlation between sonographic changes and immune function restoration. Methods A total of 100 CHB patients who received TAF monotherapy (25 mg/day) for at least 24 months were retrospectively enrolled. A seven-parameter semi-quantitative US score, encompassing liver echogenicity, capsular contour, margin shape, vessel clarity, portal vein diameter (PVD), spleen thickness (ST), and splenic vein velocity (SVV), was calculated at baseline, 12 months, and 24 months. Concurrently, serum hepatitis B virus (HBV) deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA), alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), peripheral T-cell subsets, including cluster of differentiation 3-positive (CD3 + ), CD4 + , CD8 + T cells, CD4+/CD8+ ratio, and natural killer (NK) cell activity were measured. Correlations between US scores and biochemical/immune parameters were analyzed. Results At 24 months, all patients achieved HBV DNA <20 IU/mL, with ALT and AST normalization rates of 92% and 95%, respectively. The comprehensive US score decreased significantly from 7.86 ± 1.73 at baseline to 3.37 ± 0.95 at 24 months ( P < 0.001), with the most pronounced improvements observed in capsular smoothness and parenchymal homogeneity. The CD4 + T-cell proportion and CD4 + /CD8 + ratio increased, whereas the CD8 + proportion decreased; NK cell activity rose from 42.7 ± 7.3% to 52.4 ± 6.2% ( P < 0.05). The US score was positively correlated with ALT (r = 0.56) and AST (r = 0.47), and negatively correlated with the CD4 + /CD8 + ratio (r = −0.46) and NK cell activity (r = −0.38) (all P < 0.01). Conclusion These findings indicate that TAF not only suppresses viral replication and normalises liver enzymes but also promotes measurable structural liver improvement, as reflected by declining semi-quantitative US scores. The strong correlations of US scores with biochemical and immune parameters support its utility as a non-invasive imaging biomarker for monitoring treatment efficacy and hepatic repair.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在利用半定量超声(US)评分系统评估替诺福韦艾拉酚胺二甲基磺酸盐(TAF)在慢性乙型肝炎(慢性乙型肝炎)患者中的治疗反应,并探讨超声影像变化与免疫功能恢复之间的相关性。方法 入选了100例接受TAF单药治疗(25 mg/天)至少24个月的慢性乙型肝炎患者进行回顾性分析。在基线、12个月和24个月时计算了包含肝脏回声、包膜轮廓、边缘形态、血管清晰度、门静脉直径(PVD)、脾脏厚度(ST)和脾静脉血流速度(SVV)的七参数半定量超声评分。同时测量了血清乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)脱氧核糖核酸(DNA)、丙氨酸氨基转移酶(ALT)、天门冬氨酸氨基转移酶(AST)以及外周T细胞亚群,包括分化簇3阳性(CD3+)、CD4+、CD8+ T细胞、CD4+/CD8+比值和自然杀伤(NK)细胞活性。分析了超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的相关性。结果 在24个月时,所有患者均达到HBV DNA <20 IU/mL,ALT和AST的正常化率分别为92%和95%。综合超声评分从基线的7.86 ± 1.73显著下降至24个月的3.37 ± 0.95(P < 0.001),其中包膜平滑度和实质均匀性的改善最为显著。CD4+ T细胞比例和CD4+/CD8+比值增加,而CD8+ T细胞比例下降;NK细胞活性从42.7 ± 7.3%上升至52.4 ± 6.2%(P < 0.05)。超声评分与ALT(r = 0.56)和AST(r = 0.47)呈正相关,与CD4+/CD8+比值(r = −0.46)和NK细胞活性(r = −0.38)呈负相关(所有P < 0.01)。结论 这些发现表明,TAF不仅抑制病毒复制并使肝酶正常化,还促进可测量的肝脏结构改善,这体现在半定量超声评分的下降。超声评分与生化和免疫参数之间的强相关性支持其作为非侵入性影像生物标志物用于监测治疗疗效和肝脏修复的潜力。

papers.title: Adherence to European AIDS clinical society hepatitis B management guidelines in people with HIV: real-world evidence from Spain and Germany.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To evaluate adherence to hepatitis B virus (HBV) management recommendations among people with HIV (PWH) and chronic HBV infection. DESIGN: A multicenter cross-sectional study. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional study in 42 centers in Spain and Germany between June 2024 and March 2025. Chronic HBV infection was defined as at least two positive hepatitis B surface antigen tests obtained more than 6 months apart. Adherence to 2023 European AIDS Clinical Society recommendations regarding anti-HBV treatment, liver enzyme monitoring, HBV-DNA testing, antihepatitis D virus (HDV) screening, and HDV-RNA confirmation was assessed. Hepatocellular carcinoma surveillance was evaluated separately and has been reported elsewhere. RESULTS: A total of 1235 PWH with chronic HBV infection were included. The median age was 56 years, 84% were men, and 36% were born outside Europe. Overall, 88% had HIV-RNA less than 50 copies/ml, and the median CD4+ cell count was 623 cells/μl. Among participants with available HBV-DNA result, 87% had undetectable HBV-DNA. Guideline-recommended anti-HBV treatment was documented in 88% of individuals. During the previous 12 months, liver enzyme monitoring was performed in 94% and HBV-DNA testing in 71%. Overall, 81% had ever undergone anti-HDV testing and, among anti-HDV-positive individuals, 66% had undergone HDV-RNA testing. CONCLUSION: Although adherence to several components of HBV care was high, gaps remain in the implementation of current recommendations for PWH, particularly in HBV-DNA monitoring and HDV evaluation. Better integration of these measures into routine HIV care may improve long-term prevention of liver-related complications.

papers.abstract_zh: 目的:评估 HIV 感染者 (PWH) 和慢性 HBV 感染者对 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 管理建议的遵守情况。设计:一项多中心横断面研究。方法:我们于 2024 年 6 月至 2025 年 3 月期间在西班牙和德国的 42 个中心进行了一项横断面研究。慢性 HBV 感染的定义是至少两次相隔 6 个月以上的乙型肝炎表面抗原检测呈阳性。对 2023 年欧洲艾滋病临床协会关于抗 HBV 治疗、肝酶监测、HBV-DNA 检测、抗丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 筛查和 HDV-RNA 确认的建议的遵守情况进行了评估。肝细胞癌 监测 单独进行了评估,并已在其他地方报道过。结果:共纳入 1235 名慢性 HBV 感染者。中位年龄为 56 岁,84% 为男性,36% 出生于欧洲以外地区。总体而言,88% 的 HIV-RNA 低于 50 拷贝/ml,CD4+ 细胞计数中位数为 623 个细胞/μl。在可获得 HBV-DNA 结果的参与者中,87% 的 HBV-DNA 检测不到。88% 的个体记录了指南推荐的抗 HBV 治疗。在过去 12 个月中,94% 的人进行了肝酶监测,71% 的人进行了 HBV-DNA 检测。总体而言,81% 的人曾经接受过抗 HDV 检测,而在抗 HDV 阳性个体中,66% 的人接受过 HDV-RNA 检测。结论:尽管对 HBV 护理的多个组成部分的依从性很高,但在实施当前的感染者卫生保健建议方面仍存在差距,特别是在 HBV-DNA 监测和 HDV 评估方面。将这些措施更好地融入日常艾滋病毒护理中可能会改善肝脏相关并发症的长期预防。

papers.title: Reactive markers of HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C and syphilis among people who use drugs in Sofia, Bulgaria: a cross-sectional bio-behavioural survey
papers.abstract: Abstract Background In eastern Europe and central Asia, HIV incidence among people who inject drugs has continued to rise, yet contemporary bio-behavioural data from Bulgaria are scarce. We measured the prevalence of reactive screening markers for HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C and syphilis among people who use drugs in Sofia and examined their correlates. Methods Cross-sectional survey of 480 adults reporting illicit drug use in the previous month, recruited through mobile outreach in June–August 2024. Capillary blood was screened on site with rapid tests. Because the outcomes are common, associations are expressed as adjusted prevalence ratios from modified Poisson regression with robust variance, with covariates chosen from a directed acyclic graph rather than by significance screening. Results Of 480 participants (78.8% men, median age 40 years), 320 (66.7%, 95% confidence interval 62.3–70.9) had at least one reactive marker. Anti-HCV was reactive in 305 (63.5%, 59.1–67.9), anti-HIV in 61 (12.7%, 9.9–16.0), treponemal antibody in 15 (3.1%, 1.8–5.1) and HBsAg in 11 (2.3%, 1.1–4.1). Reactivity was concentrated among the 304 participants who had ever injected (anti-HCV 89.1% vs 19.3% among those who had not; anti-HIV 17.1% vs 5.1%), whereas treponemal antibody and HBsAg did not differ by injecting history. papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 在东欧和中亚,注射吸毒者中的 HIV 发病率 持续上升,但保加利亚的当代生物行为数据却很少。我们测量了索非亚吸毒者中艾滋病毒、乙型肝炎、丙型肝炎和梅毒的反应性筛查标记物 患病率,并检查了它们的相关性。方法 对 2024 年 6 月至 8 月通过流动外展招募的 480 名上月报告非法药物使用的成年人进行横断面调查。通过快速检测对毛细血管血进行现场筛查。由于结果很常见,因此关联性表示为来自具有鲁棒方差的修正泊松回归的调整后的 患病率 比率,协变量是从有向非循环图中选择的,而不是通过显着性筛选。结果 480 名参与者(78.8% 为男性,中位年龄 40 岁)中,320 名参与者(66.7%,95% 置信区间 62.3–70.9)至少有一种反应性标志物。305 例 (63.5%,59.1–67.9) 出现抗 HCV 反应,61 例 (12.7%,9.9–16.0) 出现抗 HIV 反应,15 例 (3.1%,1.8–5.1) 出现密螺旋体抗体反应,11 例 (2.3%,1.1–4.1) 出现 HBsAg 反应。反应性集中在曾经注射过的 304 名参与者中(抗 HCV 为 89.1%,未注射过的参与者为 19.3%;抗 HIV 为 17.1%,未注射过 5.1%),而密螺旋体抗体和 HBsAg 并没有因注射史而存在差异。抗 HCV 反应性从 20-29 岁时的 25.0% 上升至 40-49 岁时的 82.0%(趋势 p 检验)

papers.title: Interferon-λ receptor positive monocytes/macrophages orchestrate a pro-fibrotic immune environment in hepatitis B virus-related liver fibrosis.
papers.abstract: Interferon-λ receptor (IFNLR), a heterodimer composed of IFNLR1 and IL-10Rβ, mediates IFN-λ-driven fibrotic effects. This study investigated the involvement of IFNLR1+ monocytes/macrophages in orchestrating pro-fibrotic immune microenvironment. Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood showed that IFNLR1+ monocytes were elevated in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection (CHI) and patients with HBV-related liver cirrhosis (LC), compared with healthy controls (HC). These cells also displayed a CCR2hiCCR5hiCX3CR1hiCD86hiHLA-DRhiCD163hiMERTKhi phenotype with an IL-10hiTNF-αhi cytokine profile. Hepatic fibrosis was induced in wild-type and Ifnlr1-knockout (Ifnlr1-/-) mice using carbon tetrachloride and recombinant adeno-associated virus 8-1.3HBV. Ifnlr1 deficiency down-regulated CCR2 and CCR5 expression on monocytes/macrophages, attenuated collagen deposition, but enhanced HBV-DNA replication. In vitro, bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) were co-cultured with hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) or naive CD4+ T cells to assess the functional impact of IFNLR1+ macrophages. Concurrently, the involvement of lipid metabolism in IFN-λ/IFNLR1-mediated macrophage regulation was examined using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists/antagonists. Ifnlr1-/- BMDMs exhibited a diminished capacity to activate HSCs and drive regulatory T cells differentiation. Mechanistically, IFN-λ-IFNLR1 signaling suppressed LXR-dependent lipid metabolism, thereby promoting tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α and IL-1β production, and LXR pathway inhibition favored M1-macrophage polarization. Collectively, IFNLR1 identifies a pro-fibrotic and immunoregulatory monocyte/macrophage subset. Targeting IFNLR1-LXR axis may represent promising anti-fibrotic strategies for HBV-related liver fibrosis.

papers.title_zh: 干扰素 λ 受体阳性单核细胞/巨噬细胞在 乙型肝炎病毒 相关肝纤维化中协调促纤维化免疫环境。
papers.source_body_en: Interferon-λ receptor (IFNLR), a heterodimer composed of IFNLR1 and IL-10Rβ, mediates IFN-λ-driven fibrotic effects. Ifnlr1 deficiency down-regulated CCR2 and CCR5 expression on monocytes/macrophages, attenuated collagen deposition, but enhanced HBV-DNA replication. Concurrently, the involvement of lipid metabolism in IFN-λ/IFNLR1-mediated macrophage regulation was examined using liver X receptor (LXR) agonists/antagonists. Ifnlr1-/- BMDMs exhibited a diminished capacity to activate HSCs and drive regulatory T cells differentiation. Mechanistically, IFN-λ-IFNLR1 signaling suppressed LXR-dependent lipid metabolism, thereby promoting tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α and IL-1β production, and LXR pathway inhibition favored M1-macrophage polarization. Collectively, IFNLR1 identifies a pro-fibrotic and immunoregulatory monocyte/macrophage subset. Targeting IFNLR1-LXR axis may represent promising anti-fibrotic strategies for HBV-related liver fibrosis.
papers.abstract_zh: 干扰素-λ 受体 (IFNLR) 是一种由 IFNLR1 和 IL-10Rβ 组成的异二聚体,介导 IFN-λ 驱动的纤维化作用。本研究调查了 IFNLR1+ 单核细胞/巨噬细胞在协调促纤维化免疫微环境中的参与情况。外周血流式细胞术分析显示,与健康对照(HC)相比,慢性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染(CHI)患者和HBV相关肝硬化(LC)患者的IFNLR1+单核细胞升高。这些细胞还表现出 CCR2hiCCR5hiCX3CR1hiCD86hiHLA-DRhiCD163hiMERTKhi 表型和 IL-10hiTNF-αhi 细胞因子谱。使用四氯化碳和重组腺相关病毒 8-1.3HBV 在野生型和 Ifnlr1 敲除 (Ifnlr1-/-) 小鼠中诱导肝纤维化。Ifnlr1缺陷下调单核细胞/巨噬细胞上的CCR2和CCR5表达,减弱胶原蛋白沉积,但增强HBV-DNA复制。在体外,将骨髓源性巨噬细胞 (BMDM) 与肝星状细胞 (HSC) 或初始 CD4+ T 细胞共培养,以评估 IFNLR1+ 巨噬细胞的功能影响。同时,使用肝脏 X 受体 (LXR) 激动剂/拮抗剂检查了脂质代谢在 IFN-λ/IFNLR1 介导的巨噬细胞调节中的参与情况。Ifnlr1-/- BMDM 激活 HSC 和驱动调节性 T 细胞分化的能力减弱。从机制上讲,IFN-λ-IFNLR1信号传导抑制LXR依赖性脂质代谢,从而促进肿瘤坏死因子(TNF)-α和IL-1β的产生,并且LXR通路抑制有利于M1巨噬细胞极化。总的来说,IFNLR1 识别出促纤维化和免疫调节的单核细胞/巨噬细胞亚群。靶向 IFNLR1-LXR 轴可能是治疗 HBV 相关肝纤维化的有前景的抗纤维化策略。

papers.title: Trends in hepatitis B virus seroprevalence in a large cohort of adult cancer patients from 2010 to 2023.
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection poses increased risks for cancer patients due to immunosuppression and potential viral reactivation. We evaluated the seroprevalence and temporal trends of HBV exposure in a large cohort of cancer patients in Brazil. METHODS: Adult patients who underwent anti-HBc testing at a quaternary oncology center between 2010 and 2023 were included in this retrospective study, and HBV exposure was defined as anti-HBc positivity. Temporal trends were assessed by using linear regression, whereas associated factors were evaluated by using multivariable logistic regression. RESULTS: Anti-HBc testing was performed in 22.9% (28,869/125,985) of admitted cancer patients, and seroprevalence was 13.4% (3,857/28,869), declining from 16.5 in 2010 to 9.9% in 2023 (p < 0.001). Decreasing trends were observed across sexes and age groups (p < 0.001 for both), with a more pronounced decline among men (25.1%-12.3%). Seroprevalence also decreased significantly among White patients (16.7%-7.9%; p < 0.001) and those with solid tumors (18.8%-9.0%; p < 0.001), but not among non-White individuals (21.4%-17.7%; p = 0.246) or those with hematological malignancies (13.1%-12.8%; p = 0.136). Age ≥ 60 years (OR = 4.40; 95%CI: 3.77-5.12; p < 0.001), men (OR = 1.89; 95%CI: 1.76-2.04; p < 0.001), and non-White ethnicity/color (OR = 1.25; 95%CI: 1.15-1.35; p < 0.001) were independently associated with HBV exposure. CONCLUSION: Despite the declining seroprevalence over time, HBV exposure remains common among cancer patients, as persistent disparities across demographic groups underscore the need for expanded vaccination and systematic screening.

METHODS: Adult patients who underwent anti-HBc testing at a quaternary oncology center between 2010 and 2023 were included in this retrospective study, and HBV exposure was defined as anti-HBc positivity. papers.title: A retrospective study of HIV and hepatitis B co-infection at a tertiary hospital in the Western Cape province of South Africa
papers.abstract: Background: HIV and hepatitis B virus (HBV) coinfection is a clinical concern because of shared transmission routes and accelerated liver disease progression. Data from sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) remain limited. Objectives: To describe the clinical, laboratory, radiological, and outcome characteristics of adults with chronic HIV/HBV coinfection attending a tertiary hospital in South Africa. Method: A retrospective observational study of adults with HIV and chronic HBV infection attending an infectious diseases clinic between 01 January 2019 and 31 October 2024. Chronic HBV was defined as hepatitis B surface antigen positivity for at least 6 months. Eligible patients had at least two clinic visits. Data were extracted from clinical, laboratory, imaging, and pharmacy records. Results: Of the 179 patients screened, 140 met inclusion criteria. The cohort had a female predominance of 51.4% and a median age of 42 years; most were diagnosed through routine HIV care. The median CD4 count was 214 cells/μL, and many had advanced immunosuppression. Most were receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART), with 78.8% on tenofovir (TDF)-based regimens. HIV and HBV viral load (VL) was low, and the median HBV VL was 81 IU/mL. Liver assessment showed that 36.3% had an abnormal Aspartate Aminotransferase to Platelet Ratio Index score and 40.2% had an elevated liver stiffness measurement (> 7 kPa) suggestive either of significant fibrosis or cirrhosis. Fifteen patients died, 3 of whom died from HBV-related causes. Retention in care was poor, with only one-third remaining in follow-up. Conclusion: Chronic HBV remains an important comorbidity among people living with HIV in South Africa, particularly in those born before widespread vaccination. Despite high ART coverage, important gaps remain in fibrosis assessment and retention in care. Strengthening prevention, vaccination, diagnostic access, and continuity of care is essential to reduce HBV-related morbidity and mortality.

papers.title: Evaluation of immune response to Hepatitis B vaccine: A cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Objectives Healthcare workers (HCWs) are often at constant risk of acquiring the hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection as an occupational hazard. This can be prevented not only with complete HBV vaccination, but also by estimation of the immune response to HBV surface antigen (HBsAg). This study aims to evaluate the immune response of vaccine-compliant HCWs in a tertiary care hospital. Material and Methods A cross-sectional study of 1.5 years duration was conducted among vaccine-compliant HCWs. Antibodies in response to HBs (anti-HBs) in their serum were assessed by quantitative enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Results The results showed a significant number of HCWs (90.6%) with protective anti-HBs titre (≥10 mIU/mL). 9.4% HCWs were non-responders (anti-HBs <10 mIU/mL). There was a significant decrease in the number of HCWs with protective anti-HBs with an increase in time since last vaccination. Younger age at primary vaccination was associated with increased vaccine immunogenicity. Obesity alone and smoking combined with alcohol intake were contributors to decreased immune response. Conclusion The evaluation of immune response to HBV vaccine showed that 9% vaccine compliant HCWs did not have a protective anti-HBs titre. There was an inverse relationship between anti-HBs titre with time since vaccination and age at primary vaccination. Certain health conditions and lifestyles were shown to be associated with lowered immune response.
papers.journal: Annals of the National Academy of Medical Sciences (India)

papers.title: Epidemiological dynamics and prevention strategies for viral hepatitis B and C in the Kyrgyz Republic
papers.abstract: Background Viral hepatitis B and C remain important public health concerns because of their potential progression to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Epidemiological monitoring, vaccination, screening, and early diagnosis are therefore essential for reducing transmission and disease burden. Assessing recent trends in the Kyrgyz Republic is particularly important for evaluating the effectiveness of national prevention programmes and identifying regional and demographic groups requiring additional interventions. Objective This study aimed to examine the epidemiological situation regarding acute and chronic viral hepatitis B and C in the Kyrgyz Republic from 2018 to 2023. Material and methods The study analysed data provided by the Department of Disease Prevention and the State Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance Service. Time trends, regional and demographic characteristics, and the outcomes of screening and vaccination programmes were evaluated. Results The incidence of hepatitis B decreased 2.3-fold during the study period, coinciding with the long-term implementation of mass vaccination introduced in 2000. New hepatitis B cases among children were virtually eliminated, supporting the effectiveness of childhood vaccination. In 2023, screening of 203,308 individuals detected infection markers in 2.82%, indicating a considerable burden of previously unidentified infections. The highest hepatitis B infection levels were recorded in Osh, Jalal-Abad, and Chui regions and in major cities. Adult vaccination introduced in 2023 achieved substantial coverage; however, only 58% of vaccinated individuals completed the three-dose schedule, highlighting the need to improve adherence. Expanded laboratory diagnostics and epidemiological surveillance also contributed to improved case detection. Conclusions The findings demonstrate progress in hepatitis prevention in the Kyrgyz Republic while identifying continuing gaps in vaccination completion, screening, and early diagnosis. Strengthening these measures, particularly in densely populated and high-incidence regions, may further reduce the national burden of viral hepatitis.

source_records.title: Epidemiological dynamics and prevention strategies for viral hepatitis B and C in the Kyrgyz Republic
source_records.abstract: Background Viral hepatitis B and C remain important public health concerns because of their potential progression to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Epidemiological monitoring, vaccination, screening, and early diagnosis are therefore essential for reducing transmission and disease burden. Assessing recent trends in the Kyrgyz Republic is particularly important for evaluating the effectiveness of national prevention programmes and identifying regional and demographic groups requiring additional interventions. Objective This study aimed to examine the epidemiological situation regarding acute and chronic viral hepatitis B and C in the Kyrgyz Republic from 2018 to 2023. Material and methods The study analysed data provided by the Department of Disease Prevention and the State Sanitary and Epidemiological Surveillance Service. Time trends, regional and demographic characteristics, and the outcomes of screening and vaccination programmes were evaluated. Results The incidence of hepatitis B decreased 2.3-fold during the study period, coinciding with the long-term implementation of mass vaccination introduced in 2000. New hepatitis B cases among children were virtually eliminated, supporting the effectiveness of childhood vaccination. In 2023, screening of 203,308 individuals detected infection markers in 2.82%, indicating a considerable burden of previously unidentified infections. The highest hepatitis B infection levels were recorded in Osh, Jalal-Abad, and Chui regions and in major cities. Adult vaccination introduced in 2023 achieved substantial coverage; however, only 58% of vaccinated individuals completed the three-dose schedule, highlighting the need to improve adherence. Expanded laboratory diagnostics and epidemiological surveillance also contributed to improved case detection. Conclusions The findings demonstrate progress in hepatitis prevention in the Kyrgyz Republic while identifying continuing gaps in vaccination completion, screening, and early diagnosis. Strengthening these measures, particularly in densely populated and high-incidence regions, may further reduce the national burden of viral hepatitis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型和丙型病毒性肝炎仍然是主要的公共卫生问题,因为它们可能发展为慢性肝病、肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (A1)。该研究旨在调查2018年至2023年吉尔吉斯共和国急性、慢性乙型肝炎和C的流行病学情况(A4)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究考察了吉尔吉斯共和国2018年至2023年的流行病学状况,分析了疾病预防部和国家卫生和流行病学监测服务的监测数据(A5),并评估了时间趋势、区域和人口特征(A6)。
elements_zh.methods: 监测 数据是从疾病预防部和国家卫生和流行病学 监测 服务 (A5) 收集的,并进行分析以评估时间趋势、区域和人口特征以及筛查和 监测 计划的影响 (A6),同时扩大实验室诊断和增强流行病学 监测 改善病例检测 (A12)。
elements_zh.main_results: 从 2018 年到 2023 年,乙型肝炎的 发病率 减少了 2.3 倍,儿科病例几乎消除(A7、A8)。2023 年对 203,308 人的筛查发现了 2.82% 的人感染标志物,其中 患病率 最高的是奥什、贾拉拉巴德和 Chui 地区(A9、A10)。成人 疫苗接种 覆盖率达到 58%,但只有 58% 完成了三剂计划,凸显了依从性挑战 (A11)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,吉尔吉斯斯坦共和国的肝炎预防工作取得了进展,但在 疫苗接种 的完成、筛查和早期 诊断 方面仍然存在差距 (A13)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调,流行病学监测、传播、筛查和早期 诊断 对于减少 传播 和疾病负担至关重要 (A2)。评估近期趋势有助于评估国家预防计划的有效性,在高 发病率 地区加强措施可以进一步降低国家肝炎负担(A3、A14)。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该分析依赖于疾病预防部和国家卫生和流行病学 监测 服务 (A5) 的 监测 数据,这可能会限制代表性并引入报告偏差,并且由于证据仅是抽象的,因此可信度评估为中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景病毒乙型和丙型肝炎仍然是重要的公共卫生问题,因为它们可能发展为慢性肝病、肝硬化和肝细胞癌。因此,流行病学监测、传播、筛查和早期 诊断 对于减少 传播 和疾病负担至关重要。评估吉尔吉斯共和国最近的趋势对于评估国家预防计划的有效性和确定需要额外干预的区域和人口群体尤其重要。目的 本研究旨在了解吉尔吉斯斯坦共和国 2018 年至 2023 年急慢性乙型和丙型病毒性肝炎的流行病学状况。材料和方法本研究分析了疾病预防部门和国家卫生流行病学服务机构 监测 提供的数据。对时间趋势、区域和人口特征以及筛查和 疫苗接种 计划的结果进行了评估。结果 乙型肝炎发病率在研究期间下降了2.3倍,与2000年开始实施的大规模发病率的长期实施相吻合。儿童乙型肝炎新发病例几乎被消除,支持了儿童疫苗接种的有效性。2023年,对203,308人的筛查发现了2.82%的感染标志物,这表明先前未发现的感染负担相当大。奥什、贾拉拉巴德和崔地区以及主要城市的乙型肝炎感染水平最高。2023年推出的成人疫苗接种实现大幅覆盖;然而,只有 58% 的接种者完成了三剂疫苗接种计划,这凸显了提高依从性的必要性。扩大实验室诊断和流行病学 监测 也有助于改进病例检测。结论 研究结果表明吉尔吉斯斯坦共和国在肝炎预防方面取得了进展,同时确定了 疫苗接种 完成、筛查和早期 诊断 方面持续存在的差距。加强这些措施,特别是在人口稠密和发病率高的地区,可能会进一步减轻国家病毒性肝炎的负担。

papers.title: Prevalence and Genetic Diversity of Hepatitis B and C Viruses in People Living with HIV in the Capital District of Venezuela
papers.abstract: Coinfection between hepatitis viruses and human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) significantly increases liver disease and AIDS progression. This retrospective cross-sectional study evaluated the prevalence and genetic diversity of hepatitis B (HBV) and C viruses (HCV) among people living with HIV (PLWH) in Venezuela’s Capital District. A total of 420 serum samples collected between 2022 and 2025 were tested for serological and molecular markers, including whole-genome HBV sequencing via next-generation sequencing (NGS) to characterize viral genotype distribution and mutations. Seroprevalences for HBsAg, anti-HBc, and anti-HCV were 2.9%, 20%, and 4.0%, respectively. HBV exposure was significantly higher in older men, with no differences between treatment-naïve and treated patients. Occult HBV infection (OBI) prevalence decreased compared to 2014 data (seropositive: 7% vs. 16%, seronegative: 0.9% vs. This decline, along with the higher HBV exposure among older adults, may be partially attributed to the universal HBV vaccination introduced in Venezuela in 1998, as well as modifications in antiretroviral therapy affecting HBV replication. Notably, key vaccine- and diagnostic-escape mutations were detected in OBI cases, highlighting clinical and public health concerns. Increased HCV prevalence appears to be linked to rising intravenous drug use in the country. HBV phylogenetic analysis revealed genotype F3 as predominant, followed by F1b (Cosmopolitan clade), while HCV showed genotype 1a to be the most frequent, followed by 1b and 3a. These findings underscore the success of immunization efforts but highlight the urgent need for continuous molecular surveillance and updated public health policies, including targeted harm-reduction programs, to control viral hepatitis in vulnerable populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估委内瑞拉首都区艾滋病毒感染者的 患病率 以及乙型和丙型肝炎病毒的遗传多样性,解决肝炎病毒和艾滋病毒混合感染这一重大公共卫生问题,这种感染会增加肝病和艾滋病的进展。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性横断面研究评估了 2022 年至 2025 年委内瑞拉首都区 420 名艾滋病毒感染者 (PLWH) 的 患病率 以及乙型肝炎 (HBV) 和丙型肝炎病毒 (HCV) 的遗传多样性。
elements_zh.methods: 对 420 名感染者的血清样本进行了血清学和分子标记测试,包括通过新一代测序 (NGS) 进行全 基因组 HBV 测序,以表征病毒基因型分布和 基因组。
elements_zh.main_results: HBsAg、抗 HBc 和抗 HCV 的 血清流行率 分别为 2.9%、20% 和 4.0%。值得注意的是,与 2014 年数据相比,隐匿性 HBV 感染 (OBI) 的 患病率 有所下降,并且在 OBI 病例中检测到了关键的 疫苗 和诊断逃逸 突变。HCV 患病率 的增加与静脉注射毒品使用的增加有关。HBV 系统发育分析显示基因型 F3 占主导地位,其次是 F1b,而 HCV 显示基因型 1a 最为常见,其次是 1b 和 3a。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 老年男性的 HBV 暴露量显着较高,未接受 治疗 治疗的患者与接受治疗的患者之间没有差异。OBI 患病率 的下降和关键 突变 的检测突显了免疫工作的成功以及持续分子 监测 和更新公共卫生政策的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了免疫工作的成功,但也强调迫切需要连续分子 监测 和更新的公共卫生政策,包括有针对性的减少危害计划,以控制脆弱人群的病毒性肝炎。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的抽样偏差而受到限制。由于该研究的观察性质且缺乏随机对照试验,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Hypovitaminosis D-Induced Secondary Hyperparathyroidism with Concomitant Femoral Fracture in a Chronic Hepatitis B Patient - A Case Report
papers.abstract: Background: Vitamin D is essential for bone mineralisation and calcium-phosphate balance. Deficiency can cause secondary hyperparathyroidism and increase fracture risk. While its role in chronic hepatitis B (HBV) is not fully understood, low vitamin D levels are common in HBV patients. It has been postulated that HBV infection may alter vitamin D metabolism through impaired hydroxylation. In Ghana, despite abundant sunlight, Vitamin D deficiency rates remain high due to factors like skin pigmentation and low dietary intake. This case highlights metabolic bone disease in a non-cirrhotic HBV patient, emphasising the need for bone health assessment in this population. Case Presentation: A 39-year-old man with HBV infection, diagnosed in 2013, who was poorly adherent to antiviral therapy, presented with a painful, deformed left thigh following a low-energy fall. He denied alcohol, tobacco use, or prior fractures. Examination revealed a swollen, tender, and twisted left thigh with palpable bony crepitus and preserved distal neurovascular function. X-ray imaging showed a closed left subtrochanteric femoral fracture with signs of reduced bone density. Laboratory investigations were consistent with secondary hyperparathyroidism due to severe vitamin D deficiency, evidenced by low serum 25(OH)D level of 8.1ng/mL ( 1230 U/L. Other laboratory results included elevated HBV DNA of 1040 IU/mL while serum calcium, magnesium, renal function, thyroid profile, and full blood count results were within normal limits. Bone histopathology showed callus formation with chronic inflammation, consistent with a healing fracture.
papers.journal: African Journal of Current Medical Research

analysis.research_question_and_background: This case report investigates the association between hepatitis B virus infection and metabolic bone disease, particularly hypovitaminosis D-induced secondary hyperparathyroidism with femoral fracture.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case report was conducted on a 39-year-old man with chronic hepatitis B virus infection, diagnosed in 2013, who presented with a femoral fracture following a low-energy fall.
analysis.methods: The patient's clinical presentation, laboratory investigations, and imaging were used to assess vitamin D levels, bone density, and signs of secondary hyperparathyroidism.
analysis.main_results: Laboratory findings revealed a severe vitamin D deficiency with a serum 25(OH)D level of 8.1 ng/mL, and X-ray imaging showed a closed left subtrochanteric femoral fracture with signs of reduced bone density.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case highlights the potential role of hepatitis B virus infection in altering vitamin D metabolism, leading to secondary hyperparathyroidism and increased fracture risk, even in the absence of cirrhosis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of assessing bone health in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus infection, particularly in populations with high rates of vitamin D deficiency.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: As a case report, the study lacks generalisability and cannot establish causality, but the evidence is consistent with the hypothesis that HBV infection may contribute to metabolic bone disease.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with chronic hepatitis B virus infection who presented with a femoral fracture. Laboratory investigations revealed severe vitamin D deficiency and signs of secondary hyperparathyroidism. The case highlights the potential link between HBV infection and metabolic bone disease, even in non-cirrhotic patients. The findings suggest the need for routine bone health assessments in individuals with chronic HBV infection, particularly in regions with high vitamin D deficiency rates. However, as a case report, the study has limited generalisability and cannot establish causality. The evidence is consistent with the hypothesis that HBV may influence vitamin D metabolism, contributing to bone-related complications.

papers.title_zh: 慢性乙型肝炎 患者中维生素 D 缺乏引起的继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症并伴有股骨骨折 - 病例报告
papers.source_body_en: Background: Vitamin D is essential for bone mineralisation and calcium-phosphate balance. Deficiency can cause secondary hyperparathyroidism and increase fracture risk. While its role in chronic hepatitis B (HBV) is not fully understood, low vitamin D levels are common in HBV patients. It has been postulated that HBV infection may alter vitamin D metabolism through impaired hydroxylation. In Ghana, despite abundant sunlight, Vitamin D deficiency rates remain high due to factors like skin pigmentation and low dietary intake. This case highlights metabolic bone disease in a non-cirrhotic HBV patient, emphasising the need for bone health assessment in this population. Case Presentation: A 39-year-old man with HBV infection, diagnosed in 2013, who was poorly adherent to antiviral therapy, presented with a painful, deformed left thigh following a low-energy fall. He denied alcohol, tobacco use, or prior fractures. Examination revealed a swollen, tender, and twisted left thigh with palpable bony crepitus and preserved distal neurovascular function. X-ray imaging showed a closed left subtrochanteric femoral fracture with signs of reduced bone density. Laboratory investigations were consistent with secondary hyperparathyroidism due to severe vitamin D deficiency, evidenced by low serum 25(OH)D level of 8.1ng/mL ( 1230 U/L. Other laboratory results included elevated HBV DNA of 1040 IU/mL while serum calcium, magnesium, renal function, thyroid profile, and full blood count results were within normal limits. Bone histopathology showed callus formation with chronic inflammation, consistent with a healing fracture.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:维生素 D 对于骨矿化和钙磷平衡至关重要。缺乏会导致继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进并增加骨折风险。虽然维生素 D 在 慢性乙型肝炎 (HBV) 中的作用尚不完全清楚,但维生素 D 水平低在 HBV 患者中很常见。据推测,乙型肝炎病毒感染可能通过羟基化受损而改变维生素 D 代谢。在加纳,尽管阳光充足,但由于皮肤色素沉着和饮食摄入量低等因素,维生素 D 缺乏率仍然很高。该病例强调了非肝硬化乙型肝炎患者的代谢性骨病,强调了对该人群进行骨骼健康评估的必要性。病例介绍:一名 39 岁男性,患有 HBV 感染,于 2013 年诊断,他对 抗病毒药物 治疗的依从性较差,低能量跌倒后出现左大腿疼痛、变形。他否认饮酒、吸烟或曾骨折。检查发现左大腿肿胀、压痛、扭曲,可触及骨性捻发音,远端神经血管功能完好。X 射线成像显示闭合性左股骨粗隆下股骨骨折,并伴有骨密度降低的迹象。实验室检查与严重维生素 D 缺乏导致的继发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症一致,血清 25(OH)D 水平低至 8.1 ng/mL(1230 U/L)。其他实验室结果包括 HBV DNA 升高 1040 IU/mL,而血清钙、镁、肾功能、甲状腺特征和全血计数结果均在正常范围内。骨组织病理学显示骨痂形成伴有慢性炎症,与愈合骨折一致。

papers.title: Assessing the relationship between chronic aflatoxin exposure and hepatitis B virus immune protection in a population of children receiving nutritional support in Rwanda
papers.abstract: Chronic aflatoxins exposure may impair immune function, but evidence in African children is limited. We assessed their association with hepatitis B surface antibody (Anti-HBs) levels in Rwandan children receiving nutritional support for malnutrition recovery or prevention. A total of 216 children aged 7–59 months were enrolled, including 70 malnutrition cases and 146 controls. Anti-HBs concentrations were measured using the ARCHITECT System (Abbott Diagnostics), and aflatoxins (AFB1, AFB2, AFG1, AFG2 and AFB1-lysine) were quantified by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS). Anti-HBs levels were highly variable (median = 84.8 IU/ml, IQR 14.0–283.4). Serum analysis for AFB1-lysine revealed a mean concentration of 23.43 ± 5.76 pg/mg albumin, while none of the samples showed detectable levels of AFB1, AFB2, AFG1, or AFG2 above the limit of detection. In unadjusted analyses, no significant differences in Anti-HBs or aflatoxin levels were observed between cases and controls (Mann–Whitney U, p = 0.452 and p = 0.119, respectively) or between sexs (t-test, p = 0.642 and p = 0.352). Age was not correlated with aflatoxin levels (r = 0.06, p = 0.556). In multivariable linear regression analyses adjusting for age, place of residence, socioeconomic status, and sex, nutritional status emerged as a significant determinant of Anti-HBs levels. Specifically, the control group had higher Anti-HBs levels than the case group (β = 0.573, 95% CI 0.076–1.070, p = 0.024), while aflatoxin exposure showed no independent association with Anti-HBs levels (β = − 0.003, 95% CI − 0.031–0.025, p = 0.832). These findings suggest that, in this population, nutritional status rather than chronic aflatoxins burden, is the primary determinant of Anti-HBs response, highlighting the importance of targeted nutritional interventions to support immune protection in children.

papers.title: Biological interpretation of baseline hepatitis B surface antigen and cirrhosis in determining interferon treatment duration
papers.abstract: The recent identification of baseline hepatitis B surface antigen and cirrhosis as independent predictors of extended interferon therapy provides a valuable clinical framework, yet the biological mechanisms underlying these associations require further elucidation. In this opinion review, we interpret these factors not merely as statistical covariates but as pathological surrogates for the virus-host equilibrium. We propose that high baseline hepatitis B surface antigen may reflect a deeply entrenched intrahepatic viral reservoir and may create an antigen-rich environment that impairs effective antiviral immunity. Concurrently, cirrhosis may be better understood as a spectrum of architectural remodeling in which vascular changes and sinusoidal defenestration could limit immune surveillance and affect local therapeutic access. Consequently, treatment durations exceeding 48 weeks may be required, at least in part, to overcome these profound immunological and structural barriers. We advocate shifting future predictive modeling from binary clinical definitions to a granular integration of viral kinetics and histological morphology to refine precision medicine in chronic hepatitis B.

papers.title: In silico-based Exploration of Moringa oleifera Phytochemicals as Potential Inhibitors of the Hepatitis B Virus X Protein
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health concern. The HBV X protein (HBx) plays an important role in viral gene regulation and replication and represents a potential molecular target for antiviral compound screening. Aim: This study evaluated the predicted interactions of selected Moringa oleifera phytochemicals with HBx using in silico approaches. Materials and Methods: Five M. oleifera phytochemicals (quercetin, rutin, chlorogenic acid, gallic acid, and moringin) and gambogic acid, used as a reference compound, were evaluated against HBx. Toxicity profiles were predicted using ProTox-II, while molecular docking was performed using PyRx. Protein–ligand interactions were subsequently analyzed using BIOVIA Discovery Studio. Results: All six compounds were predicted to be inactive for hepatotoxicity. Rutin, chlorogenic acid, moringin and gambogic acid were predicted to be inactive across all assessed toxicity endpoints. These compounds also showed favourable predicted binding affinities in PyRx, with interactions involving key HBx residues, including Leu93, Pro90 and Thr97. Rutin, chlorogenic acid, and quercetin exhibited particularly favourable predicted interactions with the HBx binding site. Conclusion: The in silico analysis identified several M. oleifera phytochemicals with favourable predicted toxicity profiles and interactions with HBx, particularly rutin, chlorogenic acid, and quercetin. These findings suggest that these compounds may interact with HBx and potentially modulate HBx-associated molecular processes. However, experimental studies are required to validate these computational predictions and determine their biological relevance.

However, the study's reliance on computational models highlights the need for experimental validation to confirm biological relevance. The results may contribute to the development of novel antiviral strategies targeting HBx, particularly in the context of chronic hepatitis B and related diseases.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染仍然是全球主要的健康问题。HBV X 蛋白 (HBx) 在病毒基因调控和复制中发挥着重要作用,是 抗病毒药物 化合物筛选的潜在分子靶标。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用计算机方法评估了选定的辣木植物化学物质与 HBx 的预测相互作用。使用五种辣木植物化学物质(槲皮素、芦丁、绿原酸、没食子酸和辣木苷)和藤黄酸作为参考化合物,针对 HBx 进行评估。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ProTox-II 预测毒性特征,同时使用 PyRx 进行分子对接。随后使用 BIOVIA Discovery Studio 分析蛋白质-配体相互作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 预计所有六种化合物均无肝毒性。芦丁、绿原酸、辣木苷和藤黄酸预计在所有评估的毒性终点均无活性。这些化合物还在 PyRx 中表现出良好的预测结合亲和力,相互作用涉及关键 HBx 残基,包括 Leu93、Pro90 和 Thr97。芦丁、绿原酸和槲皮素与 HBx 结合位点表现出特别有利的预测相互作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明这些化合物可能与 HBx 相互作用并可能调节 HBx 相关的分子过程。计算机分析确定了几种具有良好预测毒性特征以及与 HBx 相互作用的辣木植物化学物质,特别是芦丁、绿原酸和槲皮素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为未来的实验研究提供信息,以验证计算预测并确定这些化合物在靶向 HBx 方面的生物学相关性。这些化合物可能会在调节 HBx 相关分子过程方面发挥治疗潜力。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 然而,需要实验研究来验证这些计算预测并确定它们的生物学相关性。该证据基于计算机分析,可能无法完全捕捉生物复杂性。

papers.title: Hepatitis B elimination in Africa by 2030 requires urgent scale up of birth dose vaccination, maternal antiviral prophylaxis and political action
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B elimination in Africa is unlikely to be achieved by 2030 unless prevention and care systems are urgently strengthened. Despite progress in infant vaccination, the World Health Organization (WHO) African Region continues to have very low timely hepatitis B birth-dose coverage and major gaps in diagnosis and treatment. Routine antenatal screening for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), timely birth-dose vaccination, and access to maternal antiviral prophylaxis remain insufficient, allowing mother-to-child transmission of hepatitis B virus (HBV) to sustain new chronic infections. Elimination therefore requires an integrated package: vaccination within 24 h of birth, including community delivery for non-facility births; maternal screening and tenofovir prophylaxis where indicated; decentralized diagnosis and treatment; reliable financing and supplies; and surveillance. Recent international support for hepatitis B birth-dose introduction creates an important implementation opportunity, but political commitment will be essential to translate policy into coverage.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need to strengthen prevention and care systems to achieve hepatitis B elimination in Africa by 2030. The authors highlight that current efforts are insufficient to meet this goal.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study focuses on the African Region, where timely hepatitis B birth-dose coverage and diagnosis and treatment gaps persist despite progress in infant vaccination. It evaluates the current state of prevention and care systems across this region.
analysis.methods: The authors analyze the existing prevention and care systems through a review of public health data, policy frameworks, and implementation strategies. They assess the coverage of birth-dose vaccination, maternal antiviral prophylaxis, and the availability of decentralized diagnosis and treatment.
analysis.main_results: The study reports that birth-dose vaccination coverage is very low, maternal antiviral prophylaxis is insufficient, and diagnosis and treatment systems are inadequate. These deficiencies allow mother-to-child transmission of HBV to sustain new chronic infections.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that an integrated package of interventions, including birth-dose vaccination, maternal screening, and prophylaxis, is necessary to eliminate hepatitis B in Africa. They emphasize the importance of political commitment to translate policy into practice.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the urgent need for strengthening prevention and care systems, particularly through birth-dose vaccination, maternal antiviral prophylaxis, and decentralized diagnosis and treatment, to reduce the burden of hepatitis B in Africa.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on an abstract-only analysis, which limits the depth of its evidence. However, it provides a clear and grounded assessment of current gaps in hepatitis B prevention and care systems in the African Region, supporting a moderate confidence level.

analysis.summary_en: This study highlights the urgent need to strengthen prevention and care systems to achieve hepatitis B elimination in Africa by 2030. It identifies critical gaps in birth-dose vaccination coverage, maternal antiviral prophylaxis, and diagnosis and treatment. The authors argue that an integrated approach, including timely vaccination, screening, and decentralized care, is essential. They stress the importance of political commitment to implement these strategies effectively. The study's findings underscore the necessity of improving public health infrastructure and ensuring access to interventions. While based on abstract-only evidence, the analysis provides a moderate confidence assessment of the current challenges and potential solutions.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究重点关注非洲地区,尽管婴儿 疫苗接种 方面取得了进展,但该地区乙型肝炎出生剂量覆盖的及时性以及 诊断 和 治疗 方面的差距仍然存在。它评估了该地区预防和护理系统的现状。
analysis_zh.methods: 作者通过回顾公共卫生数据、政策框架和实施策略,分析了现有的预防和护理系统。他们评估了出生剂量 疫苗接种、孕产妇 抗病毒药物 预防的覆盖范围,以及分散式 诊断 和 治疗 的可用性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究报告称,出生剂量 疫苗接种 覆盖率非常低,孕产妇 抗病毒药物 预防不足,诊断 和 治疗 系统也不充分。这些缺陷使得 HBV 母婴 传播 能够维持新的慢性感染。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,要消除非洲的乙型肝炎,必须采取一揽子综合干预措施,包括出生剂量 疫苗接种、孕产妇筛查和预防。他们强调政治承诺将政策付诸实践的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,迫切需要加强预防和护理系统,特别是通过出生剂量 疫苗接种、孕产妇 抗病毒药物 预防以及分散的 诊断 和 治疗,以减轻非洲的乙型肝炎负担。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象分析,这限制了其证据的深度。然而,它对非洲区域乙型肝炎预防和护理系统目前的差距提供了明确而扎实的评估,支持适度的置信度。

papers.title: Development and internal validation of a CatBoost–SHAP-guided nomogram for significant liver fibrosis in children with chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: Background Significant liver fibrosis can develop in children with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), yet liver biopsy is invasive and unsuitable for repeated assessment. We developed an interpretable, non-invasive prediction model for significant fibrosis in pediatric CHB and evaluated whether baseline risk stratification was associated with subsequent treatment outcomes. Methods This retrospective study included 232 children with CHB who underwent liver biopsy, with significant fibrosis defined as Scheuer stage S ≥ 2. Patients were randomly assigned to a development cohort (80%) and a held-out test set (20%). A CatBoost model with Bayesian hyperparameter optimization was used to identify the most informative predictors, and these variables were incorporated into a logistic regression nomogram guided by Shapley additive explanations (SHAP). Model performance was evaluated by discrimination, calibration, decision curve analysis, and DeLong testing. Associations between baseline risk groups and longitudinal outcomes were examined using generalized estimating equations adjusted for age and sex and Kaplan–Meier analyses. Results Significant fibrosis was identified in 96 children (41.4%). Liver stiffness measurement, alanine aminotransferase, and platelet count were retained in the final model. The nomogram achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.828 (95% CI, 0.767–0.889) in the development cohort and 0.782 (95% CI, 0.637–0.927) in the held-out test cohort, with performance comparable to that of the CatBoost model ( P = 0.240). Compared with the low-risk group, high-risk patients showed greater longitudinal reductions in alanine and aspartate aminotransferase, whereas longitudinal changes in liver stiffness measurement and hepatitis B virus DNA were similar between groups. Conversely, low-risk patients achieved virological suppression, HBeAg seroconversion, and biochemical response earlier than those classified as high risk. Conclusions An interpretable three-variable prediction model based on CatBoost-guided feature selection accurately identified significant fibrosis in children with CHB while maintaining performance comparable to the machine-learning model. Baseline risk stratification was also associated with subsequent treatment outcomes, although external validation is needed before clinical implementation.

Associations between baseline risk groups and longitudinal outcomes were examined using generalized estimating equations adjusted for age and sex and Kaplan–Meier analyses. Results Significant fibrosis was identified in 96 children (41.4%). Liver stiffness measurement, alanine aminotransferase, and platelet count were retained in the final model. The nomogram achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.828 (95% CI, 0.767–0.889) in the development cohort and 0.782 (95% CI, 0.637–0.927) in the held-out test cohort, with performance comparable to that of the CatBoost model ( P = 0.240). Compared with the low-risk group, high-risk patients showed greater longitudinal reductions in alanine and aspartate aminotransferase, whereas longitudinal changes in liver stiffness measurement and hepatitis B virus DNA were similar between groups. Conversely, low-risk patients achieved virological suppression, HBeAg seroconversion, and biochemical response earlier than those classified as high risk. Conclusions An interpretable three-variable prediction model based on CatBoost-guided feature selection accurately identified significant fibrosis in children with CHB while maintaining performance comparable to the machine-learning model. Baseline risk stratification was also associated with subsequent treatment outcomes, although external validation is needed before clinical implementation.

papers.title: Resolved hepatitis B is associated with higher reactivation risk than chronic infection after chemoembolization for hepatocellular carcinoma
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) is a cornerstone treatment for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet the hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation risk, particularly among patients with prior infection, remains incompletely characterized, with international guidelines providing discordant risk classifications. We hypothesized that patients with resolved HBV infection undergoing TACE face a higher reactivation risk than currently estimated by international guidelines. AIM To determine the incidence and risk factors of HBV reactivation in patients undergoing TACE for HBV-related HCC. METHODS We retrospectively analyzed patients who underwent TACE for HBV-related HCC at a tertiary hospital during 2007-2025. Patients receiving baseline antiviral therapy were excluded. Patients with definitive serostatus (n = 774) were stratified into chronic-infection [hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive, n = 727] and resolved-infection (HBsAg-negative/anti-hepatitis B core antibody-positive, n = 47) groups. Cumulative incidences and risk factors were assessed using Kaplan-Meier analysis and Cox regression, with robustness evaluated through multiple imputation, competing-risks, and antiviral-naive sensitivity analyses. RESULTS During a median follow-up of 16.7 months, HBV reactivation occurred in 60 patients (6.1% overall). Patients with resolved HBV status had a higher reactivation rate (21.3% vs 6.9%; P CONCLUSION HBV reactivation occurred in approximately 6% of patients undergoing TACE, with resolved infection status conferring > 3-fold higher risk and reactivation incidence exceeding 20%. These findings support prophylactic antiviral therapy rather than monitoring alone for HBsAg-negative/anti-hepatitis B core antibody-positive patients undergoing TACE.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 经动脉化疗栓塞(TACE)是肝细胞癌(HCC)的基石治疗,然而乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)再激活风险,尤其是在既往感染患者中,仍未被完全阐明,国际指南对其风险分类存在不一致。我们假设,既往感染已解决的HBV患者接受TACE后的再激活风险高于国际指南目前的估计。目的 确定接受TACE治疗HBV相关HCC患者的HBV再激活发病率和危险因素。方法 我们回顾性分析了2007-2025年间在三级医院接受TACE治疗的HBV相关HCC患者。接受基线抗病毒药物治疗的患者被排除。具有明确血清学状态的患者(n = 774)被分为慢性感染组[乙型肝炎表面抗原(HBsAg)阳性,n = 727]和已解决感染组(HBsAg阴性/抗乙型肝炎核心抗体阳性,n = 47)。累积发病率和危险因素采用Kaplan-Meier分析和Cox回归进行评估,稳健性通过多重插补、竞争风险和抗病毒药物无敏感性分析进行评价。结果 在中位随访16.7个月期间,HBV再激活发生在60例患者(总体6.1%)。已解决HBV状态的患者再激活率更高(21.3% 对比 6.9%;P < 0.001)。多因素分析确定已解决的HBV感染(调整风险比:3.42;95% CI:2.11-5.54;P < 0.001)为独立危险因素。结论 接受TACE的患者中约6%发生HBV再激活,已解决感染状态使风险增加超过3倍,再激活发病率超过20%。这些结果支持对HBsAg阴性/抗乙型肝炎核心抗体阳性且接受TACE的患者进行预防性抗病毒药物治疗,而非仅监测。

papers.title: Knowledge and attitudes towards hepatitis B and hepatitis C among people living with HIV in Blantyre, Malawi: a cross-sectional survey
papers.abstract: Introduction The high burden of hepatitis B and C is compounded by the high prevalence of HIV in sub-Saharan Africa. HIV–viral hepatitis co-infection increases the risk of liver-related complications, yet knowledge, attitudes, and testing practices among people living with HIV (PLWHIV) remain poorly characterized. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes, and utilization of viral hepatitis testing services among PLWHIV in Blantyre, Malawi.Methods A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 299 PLWHIV attending urban and peri-urban antiretroviral therapy clinics between January and February 2025. Participants were recruited through non-probability consecutive sampling and completed structured questionnaires assessing sociodemographic characteristics, testing practices, knowledge, and attitudes towards viral hepatitis. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 27. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics and study outcomes, while chi-square and Fisher’s exact tests assessed associations between categorical variables.Results Most participants were female (74.3%), aged 35–49 years (46.5%), and married (66.6%). Overall, 63.5% of participants had never been tested for viral hepatitis, 65.6% demonstrated poor knowledge, and 85.6% expressed positive attitudes towards prevention. Knowledge was higher among participants identifying as sexual minorities (gay or lesbian) than among heterosexual participants (p = 0.039), while positive attitudes were more frequent among employed participants (p = 0.005).Discussion The findings demonstrate substantial knowledge gaps and low testing uptake despite generally positive attitudes towards viral hepatitis prevention. Integrating targeted hepatitis education and routine testing into HIV care may improve access to prevention and testing services. Further research should evaluate the effectiveness of integrated education and testing interventions among PLWHIV.

papers.title_zh: 马拉维布兰太尔艾滋病毒感染者对乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎的了解和态度:一项横断面调查
papers.source_body_en: Introduction The high burden of hepatitis B and C is compounded by the high prevalence of HIV in sub-Saharan Africa. HIV–viral hepatitis co-infection increases the risk of liver-related complications, yet knowledge, attitudes, and testing practices among people living with HIV (PLWHIV) remain poorly characterized. This study assessed knowledge, attitudes, and utilization of viral hepatitis testing services among PLWHIV in Blantyre, Malawi.Methods A cross-sectional survey was conducted among 299 PLWHIV attending urban and peri-urban antiretroviral therapy clinics between January and February 2025. Participants were recruited through non-probability consecutive sampling and completed structured questionnaires assessing sociodemographic characteristics, testing practices, knowledge, and attitudes towards viral hepatitis. Data were analyzed using SPSS version 27. Descriptive statistics summarized participant characteristics and study outcomes, while chi-square and Fisher’s exact tests assessed associations between categorical variables.Results Most participants were female (74.3%), aged 35–49 years (46.5%), and married (66.6%). Overall, 63.5% of participants had never been tested for viral hepatitis, 65.6% demonstrated poor knowledge, and 85.6% expressed positive attitudes towards prevention. Knowledge was higher among participants identifying as sexual minorities (gay or lesbian) than among heterosexual participants (p = 0.039), while positive attitudes were more frequent among employed participants (p = 0.005).Discussion The findings demonstrate substantial knowledge gaps and low testing uptake despite generally positive attitudes towards viral hepatitis prevention. Integrating targeted hepatitis education and routine testing into HIV care may improve access to prevention and testing services. Further research should evaluate the effectiveness of integrated education and testing interventions among PLWHIV.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介 撒哈拉以南非洲地区艾滋病毒 患病率 的高感染率加剧了乙型肝炎和丙型肝炎的高负担。HIV-病毒性肝炎合并感染会增加肝脏相关并发症的风险,但 HIV 感染者 (PLWHIV) 的知识、态度和检测实践仍知之甚少。本研究评估了马拉维布兰太尔的感染者和艾滋病毒感染者对病毒性肝炎检测服务的知识、态度和利用情况。方法对 2025 年 1 月至 2 月期间在城市和城郊抗逆转录病毒治疗诊所就诊的 299 名感染者和艾滋病毒感染者进行了横断面调查。通过非概率连续抽样招募参与者,并完成结构化调查问卷,评估社会人口特征、检测实践、知识和对病毒性肝炎的态度。使用 SPSS 27 版对数据进行分析。描述性统计总结了参与者特征和研究结果,而卡方和 Fisher 精确检验评估了分类变量之间的关联。结果 大多数参与者为女性 (74.3%)、年龄 35-49 岁 (46.5%) 和已婚 (66.6%)。总体而言,63.5%的参与者从未接受过病毒性肝炎检测,65.6%的参与者表现出知识匮乏,85.6%的参与者表示对预防持积极态度。被认定为性少数群体(男同性恋或女同性恋)的参与者的知识水平高于异性恋参与者(p = 0.039),而就业参与者中积极态度的频率更高(p = 0.005)。讨论 研究结果表明,尽管人们对病毒性肝炎预防普遍持积极态度,但仍存在巨大的知识差距和检测率较低。将有针对性的肝炎教育和常规检测纳入艾滋病毒护理可能会改善获得预防和检测服务的机会。进一步的研究应评估艾滋病毒携带者综合教育和检测干预措施的有效性。

papers.title: Associations of social support and disease-specific quality of life with self-management among patients with chronic hepatitis B: a multicenter cross-sectional study
papers.abstract: Background Self-management behaviors are central to long-term care for chronic hepatitis B (CHB), but the independent associations of social support and disease-specific quality-of-life domains with self-management remain unclear. This study assessed self-management and its associated factors among patients with CHB. Methods This multicenter cross-sectional study included 583 patients with CHB recruited by convenience sampling at three tertiary hospitals in Hengyang, China, from March to October 2025. Participants completed the Chronic Hepatitis B Self-Management Scale (CHBSMS), Social Support Rating Scale (SSRS), and Chronic Hepatitis B Quality of Life Instrument (CHBQOL). Hierarchical multiple linear regression, HC3 robust standard errors, and sensitivity analyses were used. Results The mean total CHBSMS score was 85.03 ± 19.38. The sociodemographic model yielded an R 2 of 0.194. Adding clinical and healthcare utilization factors increased the explained variance (Δ R 2 = 0.083), and adding social support and the four CHBQOL domain scores further increased the explained variance (Δ R 2 = 0.102), yielding a final R 2 of 0.379. In the fully adjusted model, social support ( B = 0.577, 95% CI: 0.416–0.739, p < 0.001), the emotional symptoms domain ( B = 0.170, 95% CI: 0.039–0.301, p = 0.011), and the social stigma domain ( B = 0.235, 95% CI: 0.082–0.388, p = 0.003) were positively associated with self-management scores. Higher scores in the latter two domains indicated fewer emotional symptoms and less social stigma, respectively. For a 1-SD higher value of each predictor, the corresponding CHBSMS differences were 4.79, 1.90, and 2.15 points for social support, emotional symptoms, and social stigma, respectively, equivalent to 4.79, 1.90, and 2.15% of the score range. The somatic symptoms and belief domains were not significantly associated with self-management. Robustness and sensitivity analyses did not materially alter the main findings. Conclusion Among patients with CHB recruited from three tertiary hospitals, social support, the emotional symptoms domain, and the social stigma domain were associated with self-management after adjustment for sociodemographic, clinical, and healthcare utilization factors. Further longitudinal research is needed to clarify the temporal direction and clinical relevance of these associations.

papers.title: Seroprevalence and trends of transfusion-transmissible infections among blood donors in the Volta Region, Ghana: A four-year retrospective study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Blood transfusion is a life-saving intervention; however, transfusion-transmissible infections (TTIs) such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and syphilis remain major public health concerns, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. This study assessed the seroprevalence and temporal trends of TTIs among blood donors in the Volta Region of Ghana and to identify the demographic factors associated with seropositivity. METHODS: A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from blood donors at Ho Teaching Hospital and Hohoe Regional Hospital between January 2020 and December 2023. Data from 6,147 eligible donors were extracted and analyzed using STATA version 17. Descriptive statistics summarized prevalence, while chi-square or Fisher's exact tests assessed associations. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with TTI seropositivity at a 5% significance level. RESULTS: A total of 6,147 blood donors were included in the analysis, of whom 95.1% were male. The overall prevalence of transfusion-transmissible infections (TTIs) was 8.1%, with syphilis (3.6%) being the most prevalent infection, followed by HBV (1.8%), HCV (1.8%), and HIV (1.0%). All infections peaked in 2022 before declining in 2023. Increasing age and year of donation were significantly associated with seropositivity for specific TTIs, particularly HBV, HCV, and syphilis. In Hohoe, male donors had significantly lower odds of HCV infection compared with female donors (aOR = 0.13; 95% CI: 0.06-0.28). CONCLUSIONS: Although TTI prevalence was relatively low, temporal increases and age-related disparities highlight the need for strengthened donor screening, targeted recruitment of voluntary donors, and enhanced surveillance strategies to ensure blood safety.

papers.title_zh: 加纳沃尔特地区献血者的 血清流行率 和输血传播感染趋势:一项为期四年的回顾性研究。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Blood transfusion is a life-saving intervention; however, transfusion-transmissible infections (TTIs) such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), hepatitis C virus (HCV), and syphilis remain major public health concerns, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. This study assessed the seroprevalence and temporal trends of TTIs among blood donors in the Volta Region of Ghana and to identify the demographic factors associated with seropositivity. METHODS: A retrospective cross-sectional study was conducted using secondary data from blood donors at Ho Teaching Hospital and Hohoe Regional Hospital between January 2020 and December 2023. Data from 6,147 eligible donors were extracted and analyzed using STATA version 17. Descriptive statistics summarized prevalence, while chi-square or Fisher's exact tests assessed associations. Multivariable logistic regression was used to identify factors associated with TTI seropositivity at a 5% significance level. RESULTS: A total of 6,147 blood donors were included in the analysis, of whom 95.1% were male. The overall prevalence of transfusion-transmissible infections (TTIs) was 8.1%, with syphilis (3.6%) being the most prevalent infection, followed by HBV (1.8%), HCV (1.8%), and HIV (1.0%). All infections peaked in 2022 before declining in 2023. Increasing age and year of donation were significantly associated with seropositivity for specific TTIs, particularly HBV, HCV, and syphilis. In Hohoe, male donors had significantly lower odds of HCV infection compared with female donors (aOR = 0.13; 95% CI: 0.06-0.28). CONCLUSIONS: Although TTI prevalence was relatively low, temporal increases and age-related disparities highlight the need for strengthened donor screening, targeted recruitment of voluntary donors, and enhanced surveillance strategies to ensure blood safety.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:输血是一种挽救生命的干预措施;然而,人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)、丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)和梅毒等输血传播感染(TTI)仍然是主要的公共卫生问题,特别是在低收入和中等收入国家。本研究评估了加纳沃尔特地区献血者的 血清流行率 和 TTI 时间趋势,并确定与血清阳性相关的人口因素。方法:使用 2020 年 1 月至 2023 年 12 月期间 Ho 教学医院和 Hohoe 地区医院献血者的二手数据进行了一项回顾性横断面研究。使用 STATA 版本 17 提取并分析了 6,147 名合格献血者的数据。描述性统计总结了 患病率,而卡方或 Fisher 精确检验评估了关联性。使用多变量逻辑回归以 5% 的显着性水平确定与 TTI 血清阳性相关的因素。结果:共有6147名献血者纳入分析,其中95.1%为男性。输血传播感染 (TTI) 的总体 患病率 为 8.1%,其中梅毒 (3.6%) 是最常见的感染,其次是 HBV (1.8%)、HCV (1.8%) 和 HIV (1.0%)。所有感染均于 2022 年达到顶峰,然后于 2023 年下降。年龄和捐赠年份的增加与特定 TTI(尤其是 HBV、HCV 和梅毒)的血清阳性显着相关。在 Hohoe,与女性捐赠者相比,男性捐赠者感染 HCV 的几率显着较低(aOR = 0.13;95% CI:0.06-0.28)。结论:虽然 TTI 患病率 相对较低,但时间上的增加和与年龄相关的差异突出表明需要加强捐献者筛选、有针对性地招募自愿捐献者以及加强 监测 策略以确保血液安全。

Hepatitis B update: enabling progress towards elimination. Aust Prescr 2026;49:160-7.https://doi.org/10.18773/austprescr.2026.043 Hepatitis B is a common vaccine-preventable and treatable condition. Chronic hepatitis B is often asymptomatic and can be missed if the diagnosis is not actively considered. The World Health Organization and the Australian Government have committed to eliminate hepatitis B as a public health threat by 2030. The tools required to achieve this are available: an effective vaccine, accurate blood tests for diagnosis and monitoring, effective antiviral treatments and access to ultrasound to enable early diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma. Risk-based testing approaches are not effective enough to enable Australia to achieve elimination targets; hence, the Fourth National Hepatitis B Strategy 2025â2030 calls for population-wide testing to identify hepatitis B status. Chronic hepatitis B is a lifelong disease that requires long-term monitoring and follow-up irrespective of the stage of disease or whether an individual is taking antiviral treatment. Most healthcare for people living with chronic hepatitis B can be provided in primary care. All medical practitioners and authorised nurse practitioners can now prescribe antiviral therapy for hepatitis B; additional accreditation is no longer required. Holistic care includes the provision of resources in a personâs preferred language, peer and cultural support workers, access to a long-term effective model of care, and appropriate monitoring. Continuity of healthcare providers is desirable and an important enabler of sustained engagement in care. One-third of the worldâs population has been exposed to hepatitis B, with an estimated 254 million people currently living with chronic hepatitis B (CHB).1 An estimated 227,000 people are living with CHB in Australia.2 The hepatitis B virus is the second most potent carcinogen after tobacco,3 increasing the risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) by its very presence. Therefore, unlike other causes of hepatitis, such as hepatitis C, where significant liver fibrosis or cirrhosis needs to be present before HCC risk increases, people living with CHB have an increased risk of HCC irrespective of their cirrhotic status. CHB causes inflammation of the liver that can progress to cirrhosis and HCC. One-quarter of people with untreated CHB will die from either HCC or liver failure.4 Although treatment does not cure the infection, it can prevent progression to cirrhosis and reduces the risk of HCC. In 2016, the World Health Assembly committed to the elimination of hepatitis B as a major public health threat by 2030, and an elimination strategy was developed by the World Health Organization (WHO).5 Australiaâs ongoing commitment to this elimination goal is reiterated in the Fourth National Hepatitis B Strategy 2025â2030.6 Despite having all the necessary tools to eliminate hepatitis B as a public health threat, it is estimated that in Australia, 1 in 3 of the 227,000 people living with CHB are not aware of their diagnosis and only 1 in 4 are receiving guideline-based care. In addition, only small increases in the uptake of antiviral treatment have been seen over the past decade.2 Many barriers to accessing testing, diagnosis and care exist, including (but not limited to) the asymptomatic nature of CHB, a lack of knowledge and understanding of risk factors, stigma, remoteness, the logistics of accessing care through tertiary services, English commonly not being a patientâs first language and systematic consequences of a CHB diagnosis, particularly in the immigration system. Elimination requires a paradigm shift in the care provided to people living with CHB to increase: - hepatitis B testing through population-wide universal offer of testing, treatment, enabling earlier diagnosis - primary care provision of hepatitis B testing, follow-up and long-term monitoring of those living with CHB - the number of people on treatment. Any changes in the approach to hepatitis B management need to be developed in consultation with affected individuals and communities to ensure stigma and discrimination are addressed and to minimise the personal and social impacts of hepatitis B.7 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people in Australia are disproportionately impacted by CHB, with an overall prevalence of 3.4%, compared with 0.8% for Australia as a whole, increasing to more than 6% in some regions.8 Aboriginal people in the Northern Territory have a unique subgenotype of hepatitis B virus (HBV/C4) that has genotypic and phenotypic markers of faster progression to cirrhosis and increased risk of HCC, which further increases the urgency for early diagnosis and engagement in care. Some people born overseas are also at higher risk of CHB for many different reasons, predominantly influenced by the prevalence of CHB in the country they were born in and the availability of a hepatitis vaccine as part of the infant vaccine schedule in that country. This article aims to provide an update and guidance for healthcare professionals across Australia to play their part in the elimination of CHB. People living with CHB are often asymptomatic and may have normal liver function tests, so an active case-finding approach is needed. A simple and cheap blood test for hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) and hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc) is all that is required to establish hepatitis B immune status, including the need for vaccination, or for the diagnosis of CHB. Further testing is needed to diagnose and distinguish between acute and chronic infection (IgM anti-HBc) and to assess infectivity and inform decisions about treatment (hepatitis B envelope antigen [HBeAg] and hepatitis B virus [HBV] DNA). Historically, the national testing policy had a risk-based approach to diagnosis except for the universal testing recommendation for pregnant women as a part of antenatal care. High-risk groups identified for routine testing included (but were not limited to) Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, healthcare workers and people born in high CHB-prevalence countries. However, this approach is not effective enough to meet the goal of eliminating hepatitis B by 2030 because, currently in Australia, an estimated 32.6% of people living with CHB are unaware of their diagnosis.2 Hence, the Fourth National Hepatitis B Strategy 2025â2030 recommends universal testing for all adults as a priority action to ensure all Australians know their hepatitis B status.6 There are clear recommended care pathways for hepatitis B prevention and management for all combinations of hepatitis B antigen and antibody results (Table 1).
